title: Agent Manifest
description: A declarative agent configuration with tool resource references that are resolved at runtime. Tool resources enable machine-specific and user-specific tool configurations, such as MCP servers.

kind.description: The kind of agent. Currently only 'prompt' agents are supported.

name.description: Unique identifier for the agent. Used in agent selection and resolution.

displayName.description: Human-readable name displayed in UI. If not provided, 'name' is used.

description.description: Description of the agent's capabilities and purpose. Shown in agent selection UI.

instructions.description: System instructions or prompt template for the agent. Defines the agent's behavior and capabilities.

additionalInstructions.description: Additional instructions appended to the main instructions. Useful for runtime-specific guidance.

model.description: Model configuration specifying which LLM to use and how to connect to it.

provider.description: LLM provider. Determines which client implementation is used to communicate with the model.

apiType.description: API type for providers that support multiple API formats (e.g., 'chat', 'completion').

connection.description: Connection details for the LLM provider (endpoint, credentials).

endpoint.description: API endpoint URL for the LLM provider.

key.description: API key or authentication token. Prefer storing secrets outside the manifest.

apiKey.description: Alternative property name for API key. Prefer storing secrets outside the manifest.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature (0.0 to 2.0). Higher values make output more random.

topP.description: Nucleus sampling threshold (0.0 to 1.0). Alternative to temperature.

topK.description: Top-k sampling. Limits selection to k most likely tokens.

frequencyPenalty.description: Frequency penalty (-2.0 to 2.0). Reduces repetition of frequent tokens.

presencePenalty.description: Presence penalty (-2.0 to 2.0). Reduces repetition of any tokens that appear.

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the response.

toolResources.description: Tool resource references. Tools are resolved at runtime based on the execution context (user, machine, workspace).

metadata.description: Additional metadata including authors, tags, version, and other arbitrary properties.

toolResource.description: A reference to a tool that will be resolved at runtime. The 'type' determines how the tool is resolved.

type.description: Tool resource type. Common types: 'mcp-server-entity' (MCP server entity), 'fixed' (built-in tool), 'workspace-entity' (workspace entity toolset), 'filesystem' (filesystem toolset).

name.description: Tool resource name. For 'mcp-server-entity' type, this is the mcp-server entity name (e.g., 'github'). For 'fixed' type, this is the built-in tool name (e.g., 'workspace-entity', 'filesystem').

options.description: Tool-specific configuration options. The structure depends on the tool type.
